description: This file implements the server-side handler for the newsletter campaign wizard in SuiteCRM. It manages creating, retrieving, updating, and linking campaign beans, prospect lists, and campaign trackers based on the current step of the wizard process, handling form submissions and redirecting accordingly.

methods.name: populate_wizard_bean_from_request
methods.description: Populates a bean object with request variables that match a specified prefix.

methods.name: process_subscriptions_from_request
methods.description: Creates or retrieves subscription prospect lists based on request parameters and associates them with the current campaign.
